newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Banco Saenz sells participation certs.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Banco Saenz sells participation certs.

text.p: Argentina's Banco Saenz SA said Wednesday it issued two series of participation certificates securitized by the bank's portfolio of credits for loans on electrical appliances.
Marcela Nazer of Banco Tornquist, which underwrote the issues, said they were the first certificates issued in Argentina securitized by loan credits for consumption.
The credits are based on loans granted to individuals on the balance of the price of purchases of electrical appliances from Fravega SACI.
The first series of certificates amounts to 12 million pesos, while the second series totals $3 million.
Banco Saenz has approved a program allowing it to issue up to $80 million of certificates. The issues will take place through a financial trust called Consubond.
Participation certificates allow the buyer to receive a cash flow from loans.
